thread.title: Apple stock rises after UBS hikes price target due to 'rising mix'

author: Emily Bary
title: Apple stock rises after UBS hikes price target due to 'rising mix'
text: Apple Inc. AAPL, +1.08% shares are up 0.8% in Friday trading after UBS analyst Steven Milunovich raised his price target on the stock to $210 from $190 based on the latest results of his firm's consumer survey. "The results indicate weak iPhone buying intentions but a rising mix, so continued unit pressure but potential for a flat-to-up ASP," he wrote, referring to average selling prices. Milunovich sees rising interest in the iPhone X as well as in Plus models. "Apple should benefit more than competitors from consumers that expect to pay more for their next phone," he wrote. Milunovich, who rates the stock a buy, also said that he's seen a pattern of "every-other-year" upgrade cycles in developed markets that could lead to upside potential for fiscal 2019. Shares are up 23% over the past 12 months, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average DJIA, +0.82% has gained 17%.
